description: THE ONLY WAY to create PDF files or slide decks. Call this tool DIRECTLY (via tool_search) the moment the user asks for a PDF, slides, or presentation — never write PDFs manually with other tools. Creates a complete multi-slide PDF from a structured slides JSON: one fixed-size HTML file per slide, then one editable combined PDF. ONE-SLIDE SCHEMA EXAMPLE (repeat this shape for every slide, changing slide_no/title/body/images/fonts/colors): {"pdf_name": "my_report", "slides": [{"slide_no": 1, "title": "Intro", "body": "Short paragraph for this slide.", "images": [{"file": "logo.png", "place": "right"}], "fonts": [{"file": "myfont.ttf", "usage": "title"}], "colors": {"primary": "#1A73E8", "secondary": "#FFFFFF", "gradient": {"from": "#1A73E8", "to": "#0D47A1", "direction": "to-right"}}}]}. Image place is exactly one of right|left|center|background (max one background per slide). images[].file must be the exact Workspace file name, the file_id from [Attached files], or the image_id from context — the tool copies it into the deck folder automatically; never invent short names. Colors are hex codes; gradient needs from+to. Page size is one of A4-landscape (default rectangle), A4-portrait, Letter-landscape, Letter-portrait, square — omit size for the default. If the user uploads no font, omit fonts entirely: the tool applies its bundled default automatically (Amiri for Arabic slides, Cairo for Latin slides; a declared font always wins). Use action=create with pdf_name+slides for a new deck, action=update with task_id+slides to regenerate only changed/new slides (deleted slides drop out, a new size rebuilds the PDF), action=get with task_id to fetch the stored slides JSON plus the latest PDF. All files live in one Workspace folder named after the PDF.

action.description: create: new deck. update: edit by task_id (only changed slides regenerate). get: return stored slides JSON + latest PDF.

pdf_name.description: PDF/folder name (letters, numbers, spaces, _ -). Required for create.

slides.description: Slides array in the documented one-slide schema (max 50 slides). Required for create and update.

task_id.description: Task ID returned by create. Required for update and get.

size.description: Page size: A4-landscape (default rectangle), A4-portrait, Letter-landscape, Letter-portrait, square. Optional for create and update.

name: pdf_create
